title: Remote Client

# Remote Client

The same sample-preparation workflow can use a namespace-scoped `RecapClient`
view. Scoped views share authenticated connection state with their source
client.
`from_url()` reads through GraphQL and sends mutations through REST; no server
database path or deployment layout is required. Keep API keys outside source
control. See [remote authentication](../how-to/use-remote-authentication.qmd),
[query process runs](../how-to/query-process-runs.qmd), and the [client](/reference/RecapClient.html)
and [query API](/reference/QueryDSL.html)
references.

```python
from recap.client import RecapClient
from recap.utils.general import Direction


client = RecapClient.from_url(
    "https://recap.example.org",
    api_key="REPLACE_WITH_API_KEY",
)
namespace = client.namespace("beamline/sample-preparation")

# REST mutation: create or update reusable definitions.
with namespace.build_resource_template(
    name="Prepared Sample",
    type_names=["sample"],
) as template:
    template.add_properties({
        "identity": [
            {"name": "sample_id", "type": "str", "default": ""},
        ]
    })

with namespace.build_process_template("Prepare Sample", "1.0") as template:
    template.add_resource_slot("sample", "sample", Direction.input)
    (
        template.add_step("Prepare")
        .add_parameters({
            "conditions": [
                {"name": "temperature", "type": "float", "default": 20.0, "unit": "degC"},
                {"name": "duration", "type": "float", "default": 10.0, "unit": "min"},
            ]
        })
        .bind_slot("source", "sample")
        .close_step()
    )

with namespace.build_resource(
    name="Sample A",
    template_name="Prepared Sample",
) as builder:
    builder.set_props({"identity": {"sample_id": "S-001"}})

sample = (
    namespace.query_maker()
    .resources()
    .filter(name="Sample A")
    .first()
)
assert sample is not None

with namespace.build_process_run(
    name="Prepare Sample A",
    description="Prepare sample for measurement",
    template_name="Prepare Sample",
    version="1.0",
) as run:
    run.assign_resource("sample", sample)
    params = run.get_params("Prepare")
    params.conditions.temperature = 22.5
    params.conditions.duration = 12.0
    run.set_params(params)
    run.finalize()

# GraphQL-backed query: read the hydrated provenance record.
result = (
    namespace.query_maker()
    .process_runs()
    .filter(name="Prepare Sample A")
    .include_steps(include_parameters=True)
    .include_resources()
    .first()
)
assert result is not None
print(result.assigned_resources["sample"].resource.name)
print(result.steps["Prepare"].parameters.conditions.model_dump())
client.close()
```

Remote namespace paths and API permissions are deployment-specific; this example
only requires a reachable RECAP URL and credentials accepted by that server.
